user.title: Choose your bike
user.description: Bikes Home Assistant can hear over Bluetooth right now. Wake the console if yours is missing.

strava.title: Strava
strava.description: Upload each finished ride to Strava? You can also do this later under Reconfigure.

abort.already_configured: This bike is already set up.
abort.no_devices_found: No iFit bike is in range over Bluetooth. Wake the bike's console and try again.
abort.use_reconfigure: Your bike is already set up. To connect Strava, open iFit Bike and choose Reconfigure; for speed settings, choose Configure.

data_description.wheel_ratio: The bike reports no speed, so speed = this x cadence. If the console's distance is higher than Home Assistant's, raise it. Applies immediately.

application_credentials.description: Create an API application at {strava_api_url}. Set its Authorization Callback Domain to my.home-assistant.io, then enter its Client ID and Client Secret here.
